articles.summary: GUANGZHOU, China, May 11, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Vipshop Holdings Limited (NYSE: VIPS), a leading off-price retailer in China (" Vipshop " or the "Company"), today announced that it plans to release its first quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, May 21, 2026, before the US market open.
articles.title: Vipshop to Announce First Quarter 2026 Financial Results on May 21, 2026
